invariants.description: f_NTS_output is the sum of the four NTS subtype outputs
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(f_NTS_output - (f_NTS_br + f_NTS_ls + f_NTS_cp + f_NTS_ch))) <= 1e-9 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(f_NTS_output)))

invariants.description: RSA gate: f_NA_input = f_NTS_output if s_floor > 0.4 else k_RSA f_NTS_output
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(f_NA_input - (np.where(s_floor > 0.4, 1.0, k_RSA)*(f_NTS_br + f_NTS_ls + f_NTS_cp + f_NTS_ch)))) <= 1e-9 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(f_NA_input)))

invariants.description: f_NA is the exact Gee 2023 sigmoid of its input
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs(f_NA - (((f_min_NA - f_max_NA)/(1 + (np.where(s_floor > 0.4, 1.0, k_RSA)*(f_NTS_br + f_NTS_ls + f_NTS_cp + f_NTS_ch)/f_mid_NA)**k_NA) + f_max_NA)))) <= 1e-9 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(f_NA)))

bc_sweep.rationale: s_floor over the whole respiratory phase [0, 1] (both gate states); NTS outputs over their sigmoid ranges; k_RSA 0-1 (full gating to none); other constants x0.5-x2.

baseline.reason: intermediate neuronal population of the Gee 2023 reflex network: its firing rate is not measured on its own (parameters were identified from whole-system HR/elastance/ICN data), so there is no component-level data; checked against its exact static map. Validation belongs to the assembled closed-loop model (candidate: Gee 2023 Table 2 baseline SBP/DBP/HR/CO/EF and VNS % changes).
